task.title: Add directives collapsible to VSCode extension
task.description: Add a collapsible DIRECTIVES section to the VSCode kanban view that displays workflows with their assigned directives. Each workflow expands via chevron to reveal its directives.
task.problem: Users cannot see which directives are assigned to which workflow/skill from the VSCode kanban view. They must manually check config files to understand what custom instructions apply to each phase.
task.value: Quick visibility into directive assignments directly from the sidebar. Users can see at a glance what custom instructions apply to each workflow phase and click to open directive files for editing.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the user opens the VSCode kanban view When the view loads Then a collapsible "DIRECTIVES" section appears after task columns and before Product Docs
Given the DIRECTIVES section is expanded When the user views the section Then each workflow (festina-create, festina-scope, etc.) shows as a row with a chevron
Given a workflow has assigned directives When the user clicks the workflow chevron to expand Then the assigned directives appear as children underneath the workflow
Given a directive exists in the directives folder When the user clicks on the directive item Then the directive XML file opens in the editor
Given a directive is referenced but the file does not exist When the user views the directive item Then the directive displays with a warning icon and is non-clickable
